Traffic Commission Meeting
Public Comment from the Audience
•
If you wish to address the Traffic Commission, please complete a Speaker Request Card, as it must be handed to the City Clerk before the start of the meeting.
•
The Traffic Commission will hear public comments on matters not listed on the agenda during the Public Comments from the Audience period.
•
Opportunity to address the Traffic Commission (on non-agenda items) is limited to 3 minutes per speaker.
•
The Traffic Commission will hear public comments on items listed on the agenda during discussion of the matter and prior to a vote.
Brown Act
Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.
Rules of Decorum
Persons attending the meeting shall observe rules of propriety, decorum, good conduct, and refrain from impertinent or slanderous remarks. Violation of this rule shall result in such persons being barred from further audience before the governing body. Pursuant to Gov. Code Sect. 54954.3(c), any person who engages in unlawful interference shall be removed from chambers.
Americans with Disabilities Act
In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, please contact the City Clerk's office at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to allow the City to make reasonable arrangements to ensure accessibility to the meeting or service.
This agenda was posted 72 hours in advance of the meeting at the City Hall, 8838 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; the L.A. County Library, Rosemead Branch, 8800 E. Valley Boulevard, Rosemead; and other locations pursuant to RMC Sec. 1.08.020. Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the Rosemead Traffic Commission regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.

NEW BUSINESS
A.
Line of Sight Review at the Intersection of Fern Avenue and Pine Street
SUMMARY
The City of Rosemead has received a resident request to evaluate the line-of-sight visibility and existing roadway conditions at the intersection of Fern Avenue and Pine Street. In response to this request and on behalf of the City, engineering staff completed a curb marking review to determine if additional red curb is warranted to increase visibility for drivers turning from Fern Avenue onto Pine Street. The resident reported that vehicles park up to the curb returns on Pine Street, making it difficult for vehicles approaching the intersection on Fern Avenue to see approaching and oncoming traffic on Pine Street. In response to this request and on behalf of the City, engineering staff completed a traffic review and recommended appropriate measures.
After a thorough review of existing field and traffic conditions and per the guidelines in the California Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (CAMUTCD), California Vehicle Code (CVC), and based on engineering judgement, it was determined that 80-feet of red curb should be installed on either side of the street along Pine Street at Fern Avenue.
CEQA: Not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act.
STAFF RECOMMENDATION
1.
INSTALL RED CURB ALONG PINE AVENUE, NORTH OF THE INTERSECTION WITH FERN AVENUE: Install of red curb along Pine Avenue on the east side and west side of the street, north of the intersection with Fern Avenue, for a total of 40-feet of red curb installed. (Per CAMUTCD Section 3B.23):
a.
Install 20-feet of red curb on the east side of Pine Avenue north of the intersection with Fern Avenue.
b.
Install 20-feet of red curb on the west side of Pine Avenue north of the intersection with Fern Avenue.
c.
Installation of the red curb on the north side of the intersection on Pine Street at Fern Avenue will remove 2 parking spaces.
2.
INSTALL RED CURB ALONG PINE AVENUE, SOUTH OF THE INTERSECTION WITH FERN AVENUE: Install of red curb along Pine Avenue on the east side and west side of the street, south of the intersection with Fern Avenue, for a total of 40-feet of red curb installed. (Per CAMUTCD Section 3B.23):
a.
Install 20-feet of red curb on the east side of Pine Avenue south of the intersection with Fern Avenue.
b.
Install 20-feet of red curb on the west side of Pine Avenue south of the intersection with Fern Avenue.
c.
Installation of the red curb on the south side of the intersection on Pine Street at Fern Avenue will remove 2 parking spaces.
Staff Report
B.
Line of Sight Review and Red Curb Request at 2718 Stingle Avenue
SUMMARY
The City of Rosemead has received a resident request to evaluate the line-of-sight visibility and existing roadway conditions at the location of 2718 Stingle Avenue. In response to this request and on behalf of the City, engineering staff completed a curb marking review to determine if red curb is warranted adjacent to the resident’s driveway to increase visibility and allow the resident to exit their driveway onto Stingle Avenue. The resident reported that vehicles park up to the driveway aprons at their driveway, making it difficult to see, and to exit their driveway onto Stingle Avenue. In response to this request and on behalf of the City, engineering staff completed a traffic review and recommended appropriate measures.
After a thorough review of existing field and traffic conditions and per the guidelines in the California Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (CAMUTCD), California Vehicle Code (CVC), and based on engineering judgement, it was determined that red curb should be installed on either side of the driveway at 2718 Stingle Avenue.
CEQA: Not subject to the California Environmental Quality Act.
STAFF RECOMMENDATION
3.
INSTALL RED CURB ON THE EAST SIDE STINGLE AVENUE, AT 2718 STINGLE AVENUE: Install red curb on the east side of Stingle Avenue, both north and south of the driveway located on 2718 Stingle Avenue. (Per CAMUTCD Section 3B.23):
a.
Install red curb on the east side of Stingle Avenue, 2-feet of red curb north of the driveway and 2-feet of red curb south of the driveway located on 2718 Stingle Avenue for a total of 4-feet of red curb.
